policy.platform: CPU only, no GPU: one node of Slurm partition standard.
policy.forbidden: published LAMMPS benchmark results or logs (including the log.* files under examples/), or an installed LAMMPS module or binary (build lmp from the repository)

tasks.task_prompt: Build `lmp` from the repository with the REAXFF, QEQ and KOKKOS (OpenMP backend, double precision) packages and run `lmp -k on t 1 -sf kk -pk kokkos neigh half neigh/qeq full newton on -v x 16 -v y 8 -v z 12 -in examples/reaxff/HNS/in.reaxff.hns -nocite` under MPI on one node (466,944 atoms, 100 steps). Report the thermo row of step 0.

log_lines.exit status:: the run's exit code, as the last line of run.log
log_lines.Loop time of: the loop time, ranks, steps and atom count
